message:
## Short description
Fix player.play to gracefully handle AbortError when a play request is interrupted by pause.

Resolves #4047.

## Implementation details
- catch AbortError inside `Player.play` and swallow it
- add unit test covering pause before play promise resolves

## How to test it
- `yarn lint`
- `yarn test:unit`

## Checklist
* [ ] This PR is covered by e2e tests
* [x] It introduces no breaking API changes
